==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Qingling:''' I'll go to the frontlines tomorrow to capture some footage!
:{{DIcon}} Isn't the frontlines very dangerous?
:'''Qingling:''' Huh? Ah, that's how it is for ordinary people!
:'''Qingling:''' But for me, precisely because it's dangerous, I should personally experience it and truthfully convey this feeling through the lens to inform more people and keep everyone updated on the situation.
:'''Qingling:''' Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Qingling, a war journalist. I was previously working on a special feature on the homeland inside [[Jinzhou]], and now I'm here to assist Senior [[Huowen]] with the filming.
:'''Qingling:''' Being on the frontlines and reporting the truth is the duty of us journalists. Don't worry, I have experience in war reporting, so I won't encounter any major dangers.
:'''Qingling:''' It's not you, you don't seem to be a [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Ranger]]. Be careful here!
{{Dialogue End}}
